title: A differentiable physics projection layer for 3D human motion (working title)
contribution: First author. The network predicts a pose, and a differentiable optimisation layer at its output returns the nearest physically feasible one: floor contact is a hard constraint there, not a penalty added to the loss. The gradient passes through the layer by implicit differentiation, so the whole thing trains end to end. Work carried out at the University of Alberta's Vision & Learning Lab (Prof. Li Cheng).
